subtitle: Old workings under the Shattered Peaks
canonNote: Old mining tunnels under the Shattered Peaks with a mag-rail line deep down (CANON, book2 ch.19); stagnant water, rusted iron ladders and lum-tubes in the old workings (CANON, book2 ch.19); aether-geodes cut from deep seams (CANON, book1 ch.3); the Wasting eating the Peaks' stone (CANON, world_bible); the Sandthrone, the Cult of Ash, the goblins and their vibration-locks, the Hollow Men and the Silent Pilgrims (CANON). GAME-ONLY: the Sandthrone cutting geodes here and running them south on the old line, the Cult's chapter-house, the breach, the Singing Gallery's trestle, bridge and island, the singing door, every person, camp, place and event. Docs/DUNGEON_DESIGN.md and Docs/ADIT_REWORK.md.
roadsNote: the cart track from the cut to the mouth
worldMapNote: Under the Shattered Peaks, through the Sealed Adit.
objectives: Find out what the Sandthrone are cutting under the pass
Win the three rail sigils off the Gallery's wings
Stop the carriage on the dead line

exits.name: The cut back up to the Peaks

secrets.name: A Pilgrim's Bundle
secrets.prompt: Unwrap the bundle in the rocks
secrets.text: Up on the shoulder over the cut, wedged between two rocks out of the wind: a grey wool bundle of the kind the Silent Pilgrims carry, and a slate tucked in its knot.
secrets.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Silent Pilgrims are CANON (world_bible); this bundle and its slate are GAME-ONLY

secrets.name: A Rusted Key on a Nail
secrets.prompt: Take the key off its nail
secrets.text: Behind a fallen prop in the dark drift, where the lichen gives out for a stride or two, a key hangs on a nail driven into the rock. The Company never came this far with a lamp.

secrets.name: Behind the Falls
secrets.prompt: Open the chest behind the falls
secrets.text: Behind the sheet of falling water, in the dry under the lip, an old miners' chest with a rusted lock. The key from the dark drift turns in it.

secrets.name: The Lamp-Man's Niche
secrets.prompt: Search the niche by the landing
secrets.text: A niche cut in the rock at the trestle landing's back, where the lamp-men kept their oil and their pay.

secrets.name: The Struck-Out Pages
secrets.text: On a reading desk in the room behind the shelves, a history of the order with whole pages inked over, and one the censor missed.

secrets.name: The Censor's Box
secrets.text: Under the desk, a small iron-bound box: the fines the censor took from copyists who wrote what they should not.

secrets.name: The Grey Key
secrets.text: At the drift's dead end, on a nail over a miner's cot gone grey as ash: a key with no colour at all.

secrets.name: The Foreman's Strongbox
secrets.text: The Foreman's strongbox, its gilt gone dull and grey. The grey key opens it without a sound.

secrets.name: A Drowned Purse
secrets.prompt: Feel in the pool for the purse
secrets.text: In the Lurker's Pool, under a hand of black water, a leather purse snagged on a rock. Somebody's month of pay.

secrets.name: Ember-Cap
secrets.text: Low on the cloister stair's wall, where the chapel's heat seeps through the rock: a cluster of small red caps that glow like coals.

secrets.name: A Pitch-Boiler's Tally
secrets.prompt: Read the tally chalked on the board
secrets.text: A board leaned against the platform's end, chalked with barrels of pitch and the name of whoever boils it: "Old Kettle, north-west, past the sleepers."
